mapper.select: SELECT * FROM portal_topic WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_topic SET view_count = view_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND view_count + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE portal_topic SET post_count = post_count + #{delta}, last_post_time = #{postTime}, last_poster_id = #{posterId} WHERE id = #{id} AND post_count + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE portal_topic SET post_count = GREATEST(0, post_count - 1) WHERE id = #{topicId}
UPDATE portal_topic SET is_featured = 1 WHERE id = #{topicId}
UPDATE portal_topic SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count + #{delta} >= 0
UPDATE portal_topic SET comment_count = comment_count + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id} AND comment_count + #{delta} >= 0
